tablet_reference: projects/vehicle_data/dashboard/docs/design.md: portrait-mounted tablet, 800 × 1280 CSS pixels; physical DPR unconfirmed.
capture_method: Clean Chromium browser displaying the Pi-hosted production app. Browser-only reactive-store fixtures, canvas/SVG and text changes, and intercepted advisor/scan API responses supplied demo data.
data_notice: Portfolio demonstration images combine saved app data with believable synthetic telemetry, charts, trip/cruise summaries and assistant conversations. They are not evidence of an actual drive, diagnosis, model response or service action.
suggested_public_caption: Van telemetry dashboard — tablet UI with illustrative demo data.
safety: No vehicle actions, scan execution, warning installation, maintenance saves, deployments or service changes. Mutating requests were blocked or fulfilled locally in the capture browser.
